scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run redis:start && npm run prisma:dev && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
